title: Tensor pullback preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and use the additive structure of its tensor pullback functor $g^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $s:P^\bullet\to Q^\bullet$ be a quasi-isomorphism of complexes of $\mathcal O_S$-modules [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules], with $P^\bullet$ and $Q^\bullet$ K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then the termwise tensor pullback map $g^*(s):g^*P^\bullet\to g^*Q^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism of complexes of $\mathcal O_T$-modules. No flatness hypothesis on $g$ is needed.

proof.text: Exact inverse image preserves s and sends P and Q to K-flat complexes over g^{-1} O_S. K-flatness follows by using the identity adjoint ring map on (T,g^{-1} O_S), as in the inverse-image resolution theorem.

Apply the quasi-isomorphism preservation clause of derived change of rings to g^{-1} O_S -> O_T. For this application choose standard derived categories locally; no derived-category instance occurs in the statement being proved. The clause sends the inverse-image quasi-isomorphism between the two K-flat complexes to a quasi-isomorphism. Its natural object and map formulas identify the resulting termwise map with the recorded tensor pullback map, using the tensor-pullback definition.
